verdict.rationale: Zep hosts an llms.txt file at help.getzep.com/llms.txt (confirmed HTTP 200 via direct probe) with a clear summary of the product, and also runs a docs MCP server that completed a live keyless JSON-RPC handshake, giving agents multiple direct machine-readable entry points into the docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents actually use these entry points successfully in practice.
